lemmas.statement: For every canonical chart slice of the phase torus T^5, the phase variety of a fourth basis (completing the MUB6 triple to four bases) has no points; to be certified by a CAD cover of T^5.

near_misses.claim: Evidence at the single Szollosi point (1,-1,1,i) (MUB6-C41) establishes emptiness on the whole torus T^5.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: A single point is not a cover of T^5; emptiness on every chart slice needs a certified decomposition covering all cells.

near_misses.claim: The existing AlgebraicHilbertBasisTransportContract theorems yield emptiness of the fourth-basis phase variety.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The contract transports bases over finite fields and gives existence of a MUB family under hypotheses; it carries no statement about T^5 or CAD emptiness.

open_obligations: No CAD computation exists in the checkout; a certified T^5 cover is required.
